pages.raw_meta: Leverage advanced identity solutions across each stage of activation and measurement without relying on third-party cookies.
raw_blocks: See how our identity solutions help advertisers do more
Leverage advanced identity solutions across each stage of activation and measurement without relying on third-party cookies.
Reach desired audiences without cookies

Brands are using their own first-party data along with solutions like Unified ID 2.0 (UID2), European Unified ID (EUID), and our cross-device graph to optimize targeting and deliver personalized experiences in a privacy-conscious way.
Our cross-device graph provides a unified view of your customers for omnichannel campaigns.
Manage frequency to advertise more efficiently and help increase unique reach.
Use reporting to measure frequency savings, lower-funnel conversions, and channel-level performance.

Improve the consumer experience while fueling future-proof marketing tactics for activation, targeting, and measurement. UID2 is an open-source identifier for the entire ecosystem to support a more privacy-conscious internet.
Onboard your first-party data from anywhere, while retaining control.
Enrich your data with our marketplace of UID2 audiences.
Extend your reach across devices with Identity Alliance.
Measure performance through our marketplace or a clean room.
Push audiences back into our platform to reactivate your data.
Success in Short: Unified ID 2.0 helps Target Australia grow its business
Leveraging UID2 allows us to stop an over-reliance on third-party data and focus on utilizing Target’s first-party data, which sets us up to better future-proof moving forward.
Kate Long, Activation Director OMD Australia
reduction in cost-per-action than third-party audience targeting

Disney+ France discovers which channel combinations drive the most magical brand outcomes

Since launching in France in 2020, Disney+ has competed in a crowded subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) market. The streaming service relies on a premium content portfolio — including Marvel, Star Wars, Pixar, National Geographic, and general entertainment — to attract, engage, and retain subscribers.
